messages:
liz: FYI scheduling schema change for account_flags on Mon 02:00 UTC. Need a 45m quiet window and a swap holdpoint.

db-jamie: Plan: create account_flags_v2 (ghost), backfill in 6 shards, swap, feature-flag flip. Backfill uses streaming reader; expect ~10–12 r/s per worker.

kevin: Any chance of long-lived locks?

db-jamie: Ghost swap is atomic; backfill should avoid DDL locks. We'll monitor lock_waits. If we see >200ms sustained, we pause.

deploybot: migration:account_flags:1731234567 scheduled by db-jamie at 2024-11-25T02:00:00Z. React :white_check_mark: to ack. canary=1/2 parallel=2.

ops: Pin api to v3.0.2 for the window. I'll push image pin at T-20.

liz: Rollback conditions (draft): error_rate>1.5% over 5m, replica_lag>40s, sustained lock_wait>250ms. On trigger: pause backfill + revert pins.

kevin: Can we add deploybot hold before swap?

deploybot: Holdpoint added at step=swap. swap will await manual continue.

sre-bot: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ghost-backfill (auto-post).

ops: Also plan ingress slow-down to 30% for 10m around swap to reduce bursting.

db-jamie: Backfill args:
--shards=6 --workers=4 --batch-size=400 --throttle-ms=200

liz: T-30m final checklist will be posted here. Owner: liz for comms, db-jamie for DB, ops for infra.

deploybot: migration account_flags in progress (canary 1/2). logs: /deploys/1731234567/logs

db-jamie: Canary shard healthy. throughput stable.

liz: Running pre-swap smoke tests now.

liz: Smoke ok. Approving swap.

deploybot: swap executed. continuing rollout.

db-jamie: Rolling remaining shards, monitoring replication and lock metrics.

ops: Pins reverted to evolving versions after rollout window.

liz: Will close thread after 30m post-check. Great job everyone!
